description: The record of the harness's tool layer: the integration mechanism per system, the tool catalog, the loading strategy and the loop limits, with forces, alternatives and consequences.
For each external system, the mechanism that reaches it (function calling, MCP or A2A) and why.
Every tool the model can call, with its owner system, description, read-only flag, approval rule, output limit and error contract.
How a tool's failures reach the model: an `isError` result or an `error` text that names the problem and a next step.
Whether tools are sent up front or loaded on demand, the token budget for definitions and the tools that are always loaded.
